company.name: Arpari
company.shortDescription: Arpari is a commercial real estate financial management platform.
company.description: Arpari is a financial management platform built for commercial real estate. They provide CRE with treasury management, payment, and deposit account services. They offer a centralized and user-friendly treasury platform. They are able to implement better processes for tracking and managing finances.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based platform that centralizes bank data, automates cash reporting, and manages payments across multiple banks in real time.
productsAndServices.name: Arpari Treasury Management Platform

productsAndServices.description: A payment processing service that enables users to initiate and approve payments across multiple bank accounts from a single dashboard with uniform approval workflows.
productsAndServices.name: Multibank Payments

productsAndServices.description: A connectivity service that integrates bank data into the platform using real-time APIs or secure file transfers to cover all US banks.
productsAndServices.name: Bank Connectivity via API and Secure File Transfer

productsAndServices.description: A feature that automates invoice issuance, payment, and reconciliation with bank transactions to reduce manual effort in AP and AR processes.
productsAndServices.name: Automated Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable (AP/AR)

productsAndServices.description: Tools to create tailored cash reports and enhance transaction data with customizable tags for improved cash flow analysis and general ledger coding.
productsAndServices.name: Custom Reporting and Transaction Tagging
